_comment: Historical transcripts under tests/fixtures/defects/transcripts were scored on open / closedDetection / closedPrecision / closed. Those map to detection and precision only. Routing, scope, preservation, evidence and boundary are UNMEASURED until a recorded result scores them.

dimensions.question: Did the system identify the seeded problem, or correctly leave a clean control alone?
Did it cite supplied artifact or media evidence — a frame or time range, a reference mismatch, a timeline source, a manifest contradiction, a brief constraint, a pack rule, a technical measurement?
Did it identify the highest useful owning artifact, stage or command?
Did it choose the smallest sufficient correction?
Did approved or locked work survive?
Did it stay inside Video Production Skills responsibilities?
Did it avoid unsupported additional findings? Reported separately; a second finding that may also be genuine does not invalidate a correct diagnosis.

readiness: A strict diagnostic pass requires every applicable hard axis to pass. Precision is reported beside the verdict and never decides it. A correct diagnosis with the wrong corrective target is not a strict pass.
